name: Simple Social Share
description: Provides comprehensive social media sharing buttons and link copy functionality for multiple platforms
project_description: Simple Social Share provides a configurable Drupal block that renders social-media sharing buttons for the current page across nine platforms (Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Telegram, Pinterest, Reddit, Tumblr, Email) plus an optional client-side Copy Link button. Each platform can be toggled per block instance. On node and taxonomy-term pages the shared URL is a short redirect link (/n/{node}, /t/{taxonomy_term}); elsewhere it shares the current page URL. It ships icon SVG templates, a small CSS/JS library, and requires only core block and config.
